summary: Cizzle Brands filed a Form 6-K attaching a Canadian press release, its equivalent of a US current report on Form 8-K, dated October 29, 2026. The release updates timing for a previously announced share consolidation of one post-consolidation common share for every 25 pre-consolidation shares, now effective November 3, 2026, subject to final Cboe Canada approval; post-consolidation shares trade under CZZL on Cboe Canada, with OTCQB and Frankfurt listings noted. Fractional share treatment, convertible security adjustments and exchange procedures are unchanged from the October 26 release. No board recommendation action, advisor, price, premium or ownership shift is stated. What to watch: Cboe approval and any liquidity effects from the 25:1 ratio.
